about: Expected outcomes of --ai-consistency on this corpus, scored by the ignored test consistency_corpus_live. The first five pages (index, kontakt, reklamace, cenik, o-nas) are also the corpus of the mocked end-to-end test, which starts at / and never reaches the other pages: they are linked only from /mapa, where the live evaluation starts. A token matches a value of the report when it occurs in the value's text, lowercased and without whitespace, with no digit right before or after it; an all-digit token also matches when the value's digits end with it (+420 800 123 456 matches 800123456). A 'finding' case is found (recall) when one finding has a value matching each of its tokens; its priority should be one of 'priorities' and its attribute key one of 'attributeKeys' (a difference is reported, not counted as a miss), and 'pagesInFinding' names pages whose own text, not only their footer, should be among the finding's occurrences (reported too). A 'no_finding' case lists token pairs that no finding may show together (only a finding above 'maxPriority', when set); a 'consistent' case expects its token among the same-value facts. A further finding that matches an already found case is a duplicate (the grouping split its labels into two keys), not a false positive; every other finding that matches no 'finding' case, and that no 'maxPriority' tolerates, is a false positive.
